## Highlights
### New
- Let permitted extensions read clipboard text, including grade-transfer tools that use legacy paste
### Improved
- Keep the Mac Space picker centered as it fills up, with arrows to reveal more Spaces - Show the split preview just beyond the sidebar and update its landing position as you drag across the page
### Fixed
- Give Quick Window pages an even border below the address bar and around the sides and bottom - Keep saved and pinned tabs in place when adding copies to a split view, with independent page history - Start fresh mobile sessions on the sidebar or start page without automatically selecting a saved tab or split view - Open extension panels reliably after idle and dismiss popups when clicking their toolbar icon again
---
